bytes-endian.description: Little-endian initialized input, exact end, and truncated width

integer-widths.description: Ones and high-bit QWord retain full64 bits; Revision is2; short QWord is truncated

load-alias.description: Load Name/Alias/rebinding from real AML byte stream

load-capacity-work.description: Object arena capacity and whole-loader work budget are distinct and preserve supplied namespace

load-depth.description: Scope nesting limit is a recoverable resource result and namespace transaction rolls back

load-forward-reference.description: Package forward reference resolves after load from declaration Device scope, shadowing root object

load-inert-objects.description: External retained only as metadata; Mutex/Event/literal OpRegion have inert objects and no handlers

load-method.description: Unknown executable byte inside Method is retained, never executed at namespace load

load-rollback.description: Unsupported executable Add rejects whole load and restores original namespace

load-root-scope.description: Scope of root NullName works and restores outer scope

load-scoped-records.description: Processor/Pblk fields, PowerResource and ThermalZone scopes create both level and object slots

name-capacity.description: Sixteen segments fit; seventeenth parent prefix or MultiName count returns Capacity

names-forms.description: Absolute dual and parent-prefixed multi names; above-root resolution rejected

names-invalid.description: Invalid lead, zero multi-count and incomplete NameSeg are explicit errors

namespace-alias.description: Alias retains original object identity across source rebinding; collision is transactional

namespace-errors.description: Relative namespace paths and starting scopes rejected; root has no parent; failed insertion rolls back allocation

namespace-shadow.description: Nearest single-segment shadow, explicit root lookup, ancestor fallback

opcode-prefix.description: LNot composite lookahead, standalone final LNot and truncated extended opcode

package-length.description: Following-byte nibble encoding, reserved bits, three-byte length, enclosing bounds

reference-cycle.description: Missing forward references, exact identity-cycle detection, and caller work budget remain distinct

string-validation.description: ASCII span without terminator, unterminated input and non-ASCII bytes have distinct outcomes

values-buffer.description: Buffer retains declared length and initializer span without copy_from_slice panic

values-capacity-work.description: Declared package count cannot exceed object arena; zero work returns WorkLimit

values-depth.description: Ninth nested package exceeds explicit eight-frame resource profile

values-extra.description: Extra fixed-package elements yield error instead of pinned assertion panic

values-nested.description: Nested packages, uninitialized padding, sibling links and exact envelope end

variable-package.description: Literal-count VarPackage pads each missing element as a distinct uninitialized object
